title: VUA packages-catalog result v0.2
description: Result documents for the packages-catalog v0.2 read face (proposal 025 inline ruling 2026-09-17: the stale/cache-source disclosure increment; stance convergence in the proposal-025 inline thread — environment shape proposal A, desktop stance clause 5 disclosure branch, core direction ruling 6). The envelope mirrors the standing wire shape (schemaVersion/operation/result): the envelope const is the word-list-row family version 0.1; the result document carries its own family const vua.packages-catalog/v0.2 — two independent versions (the c914cf2 standing rule). v0.2 is the frozen v0.1 result plus exactly ONE new required key, cacheSourced — nothing else moved, and the frozen v0.1 word face is never revised in place (a backend that has not adopted v0.2 keeps answering the v0.1 family; the stamped const tells the consumer which word face answered, never a guess). The result projects the catalog facts of ONE package in ONE project's context. cacheSourced is the REQUIRED informational degradation-disclosure fact: true = THIS result was served through the cache-degradation path (offline -> load_cache, or an online load failed and degraded — the ORC-ADP-006 isomorphic precedent), false = served from an online-refreshed load; cache sourcing is NOT an error — consumers render it as an informational 'cached data' annotation, never a failure, and never invent the annotation when the field is absent (a v0.1 answer carries no such fact and the consumer does not fabricate facts it does not have). The packages-repos family deliberately has NO such field: list_repos is a zero-network face where the fact would be a permanent constant — a constant informational field is not a fact and gets no wire key. source is the resolved two-state origin fact of the package entity — "repo" (resolved from a repository cache) or "local" (user-local package, no repository) — and installed is the separate required project-context fact (present in this project's installed set); the desktop three-state presentation (repo / local / installed) composes these two facts, the word face never merges them. updateAvailable is the CONCLUSION of the frozen judgment (this project's installed version vs the latest compatible version by the frozen selector — a strictly newer compatible version exists); it is nullable: null means the judgment was NOT executed (the package is not installed in this project, or the project's Unity version is unknown) — absence is not "no update", and the consumer keeps the P1 defense (no update UI rendered on null, never a default false). displayName is nullable per the library's Option; null renders the packageId as the display name (P1 ruling 3), never posing as field fact. versions enumerates the repository-cache versions of the package ascending by semver; a LOCAL-source package carries an EMPTY versions array (no repository versions exist — an honest empty, not an error). Each version row: version verbatim; yanked is the repo-cache-carried yank fact (boolean; local packages have no version rows so no yank semantics arise — absence of a cache fact is never rendered as not-yanked by the consumer); compatible is nullable — boolean when evaluated against the selected project's Unity version, null when that version is unknown (null is not incompatibility); the compatibility semantics are the library's own (vrc-get-vpm unity_compatible full semantics — the behavioral authority), not a reduced general branch (proposal 025 inline core stance, caliber 2). additionalProperties:false on every object is the false-assertion guard: invented catalog facts (changelogUrl, latestVersion, downloadCount, health, ...) are INVALID by schema, not merely discouraged (P1 discipline; ORC-DEV-004: no implementation, no reserved field).

displayName.description: The package's display-name fact; null renders packageId as the display name (P1 ruling 3), never posing as field fact.

source.description: Two-state resolved origin: repo = resolved from a repository cache; local = user-local package (no repository). The desktop installed/not-installed third state composes with the separate installed fact.

installed.description: Project-context fact: the package is present in this project's installed set.

updateAvailable.description: Frozen judgment conclusion: a strictly newer compatible version exists vs this project's installed version. null = judgment not executed (not installed here, or project Unity version unknown) — absence is not "no update".

versions.description: Repository-cache versions ascending by semver; EMPTY for a local-source package (honest empty, not an error).

cacheSourced.description: REQUIRED informational degradation disclosure (v0.2 increment): true = this result was served through the cache-degradation path (offline -> load_cache, or online load failed and degraded); false = served from an online-refreshed load. Informational, never an error: consumers annotate 'cached data', they never render it as a failure and never fabricate the annotation for a v0.1 answer that carries no such fact.

yanked.description: Repo-cache-carried yank fact; consumers never render absence-of-cache-fact as not-yanked.

compatible.description: Evaluated against the selected project's Unity version; null = that version is unknown (null is not incompatibility). Semantics = the library's own full unity_compatible (the behavioral authority), not a reduced general branch.
